title: Every session sends fewer messages: an outbox, owners read their own answers, the roster is read first
why: Your ruling, Oct 26 19:40 CDT ("Yes agreed"), on the 60-an-hour message cap: the fewer-messages rules now sit only in this project's instructions.
note: Merged to main in batch PR 663 (main 1733dac, Oct 26 22:10 CDT); lane PR 660 closed as replaced. Ready for triage to close. Homes: the questions-go-to-owner rule and its decision entry, and the waiting-page skill, where the owning session reads its own answers at each wake and nobody relays them. The project-ops operating model has a "Messages between threads" section: the outbox, reading the roster before sending, no broadcast on a hand-off, and sending at once only when blocked or asked. No skill named orchestrate exists, so project-ops is that home. The scaffold now writes roadmap/outbox/README.md (red test first). Times in US Central stay a project instruction, not a global rule. Builder sonnet, reviewer sonnet. Port: yes; the rules are global. Placed ahead of c53's slot, after c88 and c97 (triage, Oct 27): every thread hits the cap.
